clue.text: Violent mama's birched the servants

indicators.note: violent suggests the letters are thrown about and rearranged

parts.note: the word written out with its S, as in mamas

explanation.surface: A furious mother has given the domestic staff a thrashing with the birch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Violent' tells you to rearrange MAMAS plus BIRCHED; the apostrophe's S counts here as a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Hotel or household maids who clean bedrooms are a kind of domestic servant.

clue.text: One to stick in clubs and hang around

parts.note: C abbreviates clubs, the card suit
to linger is to hang around

explanation.surface: Someone who stays in clubs and loiters there.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who holds on tightly, refusing to let go.

clue.text: Saint has alcoholic drink in course of work? The opposite!

indicators.note: in would put the drink inside the work
the opposite reverses that order, so the work goes into the drink

parts.note: ale is beer
a post is a job or position

explanation.surface: A holy man drinking on the job, or rather the reverse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' alone would bury the drink inside the job; the exclamation 'The opposite!' flips which piece contains which.
explanation.definitionFit: Each of Christ's twelve disciples is venerated as a holy figure.

clue.text: Church's prohibition covering mineral substance

indicators.note: covering means the ban goes round the mineral

parts.note: a ban is a prohibition
silica is silicon dioxide, a mineral

explanation.surface: A church forbids something about a mineral.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to a basilica, a type of large Roman church.

clue.text: Material placed over old books put in new container

indicators.note: in a down answer, placed over sets the material on top of the books

parts.note: rep is a ribbed fabric
OT is the Old Testament

explanation.surface: Fabric draped across ancient volumes before they are boxed up again.
explanation.definitionFit: Gardeners shift a plant into a different pot.

clue.text: Country song fellows can join in

indicators.note: join in says the fellows go into the song

parts.note: an aria is an operatic song
men are fellows

explanation.surface: A tune that men are able to sing along with.
explanation.definitionFit: A republic in the Caucasus, once part of the Soviet Union.

clue.text: Woman painter lacking time to be log-keeper

parts.note: Di is a woman's name

indicators.note: lacking shows the time is dropped from the painter

parts.note: an artist paints

explanation.surface: A female painter who has run out of time.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who writes a daily journal is keeping a record.

clue.text: What an archivist will do to be the best of all time

definitions.text: be the best of all time

explanation.surface: An archivist's job and an athlete's achievement in one phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: An archivist literally retains documents, and an athlete who holds the record is unsurpassed.

clue.text: At some stage also note error needing correction

indicators.note: needing correction suggests the words are wrong and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: Also, an error noted will need putting right eventually.
explanation.definitionFit: Eventually, at some future point.

clue.text: Old sort of sign, nothing in it portending evil

indicators.note: in it says the nothing goes inside the sign just named

parts.note: a minus is one kind of mathematical sign
nothing is zero, shaped like the letter O

explanation.surface: A traditional omen of some sort, empty inside, foretells disaster.
explanation.definitionFit: Something threatening or foreboding seems to presage harm.

clue.text: Fish ceremony attended by a small number

parts.note: pomp is stately ceremony
NO is the short form of number, so a small number

explanation.surface: A formal ceremony with only a handful of guests present.
explanation.walkthrough: 'small number' asks for the abbreviation of number, not a low figure.
explanation.definitionFit: A pompano is a food fish of warm American seas.

clue.text: Involving fingers maybe but not involving hands

explanation.surface: Something to do with fingers, yet nothing to do with hands.
explanation.walkthrough: Fingers are digits; a clock or watch with a numeric display has no hands.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to the digits of the hand, and also showing time by numerals rather than a dial with pointers.

clue.text: Strained state of numbers at home without love

parts.note: tens are numbers

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so at home goes round love

parts.note: in means at home
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: Being tense about one's finances at home, with no love in the house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' here means outside: IN wraps O to give ION.
explanation.definitionFit: Stress or tautness is the condition of being stretched or under strain.

clue.text: Army stock, as you might say

indicators.note: this signals that the word is spoken rather than spelt

parts.note: a hoard is a store or stock

explanation.surface: Military supplies, described in conversation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Army stock' reads as one phrase about supplies, but 'Army' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A vast crowd or host of people, like a marauding band of warriors.

clue.text: Nature of account in document

indicators.note: in places the account inside the document

parts.note: a charter is a formal written document

explanation.surface: Describing the nature of a report contained in an official paper.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone's temperament or disposition is their essential make-up.

clue.text: Fool troubled saint, not ultimately one to help

parts.note: an ass is a fool

indicators.note: troubled suggests the letters are disturbed and rearranged
ultimately points to the last letter of not

explanation.surface: A fool bothered a saint, not being much help in the end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not ultimately' looks like a negative, but it gives T; 'troubled' rearranges SAINT to ISTAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A helper or aide supports someone in their work.

clue.text: Elementary stages baffling true minds

indicators.note: baffling suggests the words are confused and jumbled

explanation.surface: The basics can confuse even honest intellects.
explanation.definitionFit: The basic first principles of a subject are its earliest steps.

clue.text: Designer in the morning opening a display

indicators.note: opening means the morning comes before the a

parts.note: Christian Dior was a French fashion designer
AM means in the morning

explanation.surface: A fashion house in the morning unveiling a showcase.
explanation.definitionFit: A three-dimensional scene in a museum is a model exhibit.

clue.text: Least amount of spirits — a litre!

parts.note: a minim is a tiny fluid measure, about a drop

explanation.surface: A tiny measure of spirits served, then a whole litre!
explanation.definitionFit: The smallest possible degree or quantity.

clue.text: Pure Conservative man with three daughters

parts.note: Shakespeare's King Lear had daughters Goneril, Regan and Cordelia

explanation.surface: A Tory father of three girls described as untainted.
explanation.definitionFit: Clear water is unclouded, free of impurity.

clue.text: Communion cup in church given to woman

parts.note: Alice is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A chalice handed to a woman during church service.
explanation.definitionFit: The goblet holding wine at the Eucharist.

clue.text: Priest abstaining is held to be snobbish

parts.note: Eli was the priest who raised Samuel in the Bible

indicators.note: held shows the is is gripped inside the abstaining

parts.note: TT means teetotal, abstaining from drink

explanation.surface: A teetotal priest is thought to be a snob.
explanation.definitionFit: Believing oneself part of a superior select group.

clue.text: King Charles had to be this!

definitions.text: King Charles had to be this!

parts.words: King Charles had to be this!
parts.note: a monarch must undergo a coronation to be properly king, and Charles I's head also met a violent end

explanation.walkthrough: Every King Charles had a coronation, and the word also hints at a blow to the head, apt for the beheaded Charles I.
explanation.definitionFit: Being formally invested with the regal headpiece is what makes a monarch.

clue.text: Duke with excessive yen, appearing to be slightly mad

parts.note: OTT is over the top
Y abbreviates the yen, Japan's currency

explanation.surface: A nobleman with an extreme longing seems a little unhinged.
explanation.walkthrough: 'yen' reads as a craving, but here it is the Japanese currency.
explanation.definitionFit: Eccentric or a bit crazy.

clue.text: Street dictator with a capacity for carrying on

parts.note: Idi Amin was the dictator of Uganda

explanation.surface: A tyrant on the road who never runs out of energy.
explanation.definitionFit: Endurance is the ability to keep going.

clue.text: Let in again to study at American institute

parts.note: to read a subject is to study it at university
MIT is the Massachusetts Institute of Technology

explanation.surface: Being readmitted to study at a US college.
explanation.definitionFit: To allow someone back is to grant entry a second time.

clue.text: Oily liquid, a new product one imported

indicators.note: imported says the one is brought into the other pieces

parts.note: a line is a product range a company sells
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A fresh product line that was brought in from abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: A colourless oily compound used in making dyes.

clue.text: It could be rather sleety in part of London

indicators.note: it could be signals a possible rearrangement of the words that follow

explanation.surface: London weather that turns half to sleet.
explanation.walkthrough: HARLEY STREET is the London street famous for private medical practices.
explanation.definitionFit: A well-known street in the Marylebone district of the capital.
